checks.lead: Chettathirat (Thai: เชษฐาธิราช, Jeṣṭhādhirāja), also known upon his accession to the Ayutthayan throne as Ramathibodi II (Thai: รามาธิบดีที่ ๒; 1472/73 – either July or 10 October 1529) was King of Sukhothai from 1485 and King of Ayutthaya from 1491 to 1529. His reign was marked by the first Western contact with the Portuguese.
